a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes arbitrary caller-supplied code in the storage context of the token contract.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath, allowing integer underflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, allowing underflow/overflow.
total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication in batchSend(), allows overflow.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend(), allows underflow.
Payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards msg.sender to transferFrom().
Payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) guarded by the ensure modifier; manually adjusts allowance and balances without SafeMath.
Owner-only delegate(address,bytes) that performs an arbitrary delegatecall.
Payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only batchSend(address[],uint) that multiplies _value by the array length and credits recipients; emits Transfer twice per recipient.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap-V2 style pair address via keccak256 of factory, ordered tokens and init code hash.
Payable constructor: sets name/symbol/supply, sets owner = msg.sender, mints supply and grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Modifier requiring _from or _to to be the owner or the computed UNI pair address.

Internal burn that decreases _balances and _totalSupply.

edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the source of the transfer.
transfer() delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether the allowance is decremented.
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the UNI pair address.
ensure() requires _from or _to to equal the owner address.
transferFrom reads, checks and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf entries.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are performed without SafeMath.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner.
delegate() checks msg.sender against the owner state variable.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall which can re-enter the contract through attacker code.
Target address a flows into the delegatecall destination.
Arbitrary calldata b flows into the delegatecall payload.
approve() records the allowance in the msg.sender namespace.
approve() writes the allowance mapping.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() checks msg.sender against the owner state variable.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend() subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without underflow protection.
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] inside the loop.
_tos.length controls both the multiplication and the loop bound in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited per recipient.
